query:
SELECT
            u.inbox_max_items,
            u.inbox_max_size_mb,
            CAST(COUNT(i.id) AS INTEGER) as "item_count!: i64",
            CAST(COALESCE(SUM(i.size_bytes), 0) AS INTEGER) as "total_size!: i64"
        FROM users u
        LEFT JOIN inbox_items i ON u.id = i.user_id
        WHERE u.id = ?
        GROUP BY u.id
